data.message_en:
Hi Omega Electricals And Automation, your leads dropped 47.9% last month.
There's a specific reason — and a fix.
Can we connect for a quick call? 🤝

script_parts.opening: Namaskar, Omega Electricals And Automation se baat ho rahi hai? Ji, main IndiaMART se bol raha hoon — dekh raha tha ki aapke account mein pichhle mahine leads mein 47.9% ki sharp drop aayi hai, jo ki ek serious signal hai, isliye directly aapse baat karna zaroori laga.
script_parts.diagnostic: Bhai ji, ye drop suddenly aaya hai — kya koi specific reason tha, jaise ki aapki team mein koi change hua, ya phir aap khud busy the aur inquiries ko respond karna thoda peeche reh gaya? Kyunki hum dekh rahe hain ki aapka reply rate abhi sirf 13.2% hai aur buyers jab call karte hain toh 4.1% cases mein hi connect ho pa raha hai.
script_parts.value_demo: Bhai ji, ek important baat — aapka CQS score 66 hai jo ki 75 ke benchmark se neeche hai, aur jab bhi koi buyer aapka catalog dekhta hai aur call ya message karta hai toh uska response nahi milta, toh IndiaMART algorithm automatically aapki listing ki visibility reduce karta hai — yahi wajah hai ki BL velocity itni tezi se giri hai, 47.9% ek hi mahine mein.
script_parts.action: Abhi is call pe hi ek kaam karte hain — main aapka account open karta hoon aur aapke saath milke Lead Manager settings check karte hain, specifically reply settings aur PNS number verify karte hain, taaki aaj se hi incoming buyers aapse connect ho sakein bina kisi barrier ke.
script_parts.close: Bhai ji, bas ek cheez confirm karein — agle 2-3 din mein agar koi bhi lead aaye, toh sirf ek quick reply karein, chahe ek line ka hi ho, aur dekhte hain ki agle hafte tak BL count mein fark aata hai ya nahi — kya ye karna possible hai aapke liye?

script_parts_en.opening: Hello, am I speaking with someone from Omega Electricals And Automation? This is calling from IndiaMART — I was reviewing your account and noticed a sharp 47.9% month-on-month drop in your lead volume, which is a critical signal, so I wanted to speak with you directly.
script_parts_en.diagnostic: Sir, this drop happened quite suddenly — was there a specific reason, like a team change, or were you occupied and responding to inquiries got delayed? Because we're seeing your reply rate is currently only 13.2%, and buyers who attempt to call are successfully connecting only 4.1% of the time.
script_parts_en.value_demo: One important data point — your CQS score is 66, which is below the 75 benchmark, and whenever a buyer views your catalog but gets no response, IndiaMART's algorithm automatically reduces your listing's visibility — that is precisely why your BL velocity has fallen 47.9% in a single month.
script_parts_en.action: Let's do one thing right now on this call — I'll pull up your account and together we'll check your Lead Manager settings, specifically verify your reply configuration and PNS number, so that starting today, incoming buyers can reach you without any barrier.
script_parts_en.close: Sir, just one small commitment — over the next 2-3 days, if any lead comes in, please send even a one-line reply, and let's see together whether your BL count shows improvement by next week — does that sound doable for you?

objection_handlers.competitor_platform: Samajh sakta hoon — doosre platforms bhi kaam karte hain. Lekin IndiaMART pe B2B buyers specifically aate hain jo bulk order dene ka intent rakhte hain. Ek baar compare karte hain — aapke last 3 mahine ke leads ka source kya raha?
objection_handlers.price_too_high: Bilkul valid point hai. Lekin aise socho — agar sirf 2 orders extra aaye subscription se, toh ROI positive ho jaata hai. Main aapke category ke average order value se calculate kar sakta hoon.
objection_handlers.no_time: Koi baat nahi — main ek quick summary WhatsApp pe bhej deta hoon. Aap apne time pe dekh lena, aur jo bhi question ho directly reply karna.

objection_handlers_en.competitor_platform: I understand — other platforms work too. But IndiaMART specifically attracts B2B buyers who intend to place bulk orders. Let's compare — what was the source of your leads over the last 3 months?
objection_handlers_en.price_too_high: Completely valid point. But think of it this way — if just 2 extra orders come through the subscription, the ROI turns positive. I can calculate that using your category's average order value.
objection_handlers_en.no_time: No problem — I'll send you a quick summary on WhatsApp. Check it at your convenience, and just reply directly with any questions.
